```{r}
# ------------------------
# 1. CONFIGURACIÓN GENERAL
# ------------------------
# Cargamos el setup de Inkaverse y las librerías necesarias
source("https://inkaverse.com/setup.r")

library(tidyverse)
library(GerminaR)
library(cowplot)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)

```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------
# 2. IMPORTAR Y PREPARAR LOS DATOS
# -----------------------------------
# Definimos la URL de tu Google Sheet
url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16eZ0pfgKOVMiMsAfz5IzCG9rTSpA0nHeiMpe4MsDcMM/edit?gid=0"
gs  <- as_sheets_id(url)

# Leemos la pestaña "germination" completa y forzamos tipos:
fb <- gs %>%
  range_read("germination") %>%
  mutate(
    # Convertimos plots a factor
    plots = as.factor(plots),
    # Convertimos seeds a numérico (por si acaso estaba como texto)
    seeds = as.numeric(seeds),
    # Convertimos d0…d5 a numérico, quitando paréntesis si existen
    d0 = as.numeric(str_remove_all(as.character(d0), "[()]")),
    d1 = as.numeric(str_remove_all(as.character(d1), "[()]")),
    d2 = as.numeric(str_remove_all(as.character(d2), "[()]")),
    d3 = as.numeric(str_remove_all(as.character(d3), "[()]")),
    d4 = as.numeric(str_remove_all(as.character(d4), "[()]")),
    d5 = as.numeric(str_remove_all(as.character(d5), "[()]"))
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Creamos un vector que asocia cada parcela (plots) con su tratamiento
treatment_map <- c(
  "116" = "Lija",         "118" = "Lija",         "122" = "Lija",         "109" = "Lija",         "110" = "Lija",
  "106" = "Acetona",      "105" = "Acetona",      "117" = "Acetona",      "112" = "Acetona",      "113" = "Acetona",
  "114" = "Control",      "119" = "Control",      "124" = "Control",      "102" = "Control",      "115" = "Control",
  "101" = "Agua caliente", "103" = "Agua caliente", "120" = "Agua caliente", "121" = "Agua caliente", "123" = "Agua caliente"
)

# Añadimos la columna Tratamiento usando el vector anterior
fb <- fb %>%
  mutate(
    Tratamiento = factor(
      treatment_map[ as.character(plots) ],
      levels = c("Lija", "Acetona", "Control", "Agua caliente")
    )
  )

# Revisión rápida de estructura: plots y Tratamiento deben ser factors;
# seeds y d0…d5 deben ser numéricos.
str(fb)

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------
# 3. ÍNDICE DE GERMINACIÓN (Germination Index)
# ------------------------------------------
# Ger_summary toma las columnas d0, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5 automáticamente
gsm <- ger_summary(
  SeedN    = "seeds",     # Columna con el número total de semillas sembradas
  evalName = "d",         # Prefijo de las columnas de evaluación (d0…d5)
  data     = fb
)

# Mostramos la tabla de resumen con kableExtra (HTML con scroll)
gsm %>%
  kable(
    format   = "html",
    caption  = "Resumen de índice de germinación (d0–d5)",
    digits   = 2,
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    position          = "left"
  ) %>%
  scroll_box(
    width  = "100%",
    height = "400px"
  )

```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------
# 4. TIEMPO MEDIO DE GERMINACIÓN (Mean Germination Time)
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Realizamos el ANOVA: mgt ~ Tratamiento
av <- aov(mgt ~ Tratamiento, data = gsm)
anova(av)

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------
# 4.1 Comparación de medias (SNK test)
# ------------------------------------
mc_mgt <- ger_testcomp(
  aov  = av,
  comp = "Tratamiento",
  type = "snk"
)

# Mostramos la tabla SNK con kableExtra
mc_mgt$table %>%
  kable(
    format   = "html",
    caption  = "Comparación de tiempo medio de germinación (SNK)",
    digits   = 2,
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    position          = "left"
  ) %>%
  scroll_box(
    width  = "100%",
    height = "300px"
  )

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------
# 4.2 Gráfica de barras: Tiempo medio de germinación
# ------------------------------------------------------
plot_mgt <- mc_mgt$table %>%
  plot_smr(
    data    = .,
    type    = "bar",
    x       = "Tratamiento",
    y       = "mgt",
    ylimits = c(0, 4, 0.5),
    ylab    = "Tiempo medio de germinación (días)",
    xlab    = "Tratamiento",
    glab    = "Letras SNK",
    sig     = "sig",
    error   = "ste",
    color   = TRUE
  )

# Mostramos la gráfica
plot_mgt

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# 5. GERMINACIÓN A LO LARGO DEL TIEMPO (Cumulated %)
# ---------------------------------------------------
git <- ger_intime(
  Factor    = "Tratamiento",
  SeedN     = "seeds",
  evalName  = "d",         # Detecta d0, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5
  method    = "percentage",
  data      = fb
)

# Mostramos la tabla de porcentaje acumulado con kableExtra
git %>%
  kable(
    format   = "html",
    caption  = "Germinación acumulada (%) por Tratamiento (d0–d5)",
    digits   = 1,
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    position          = "left"
  ) %>%
  scroll_box(
    width  = "100%",
    height = "350px"
  )

```

```{r}
# ----------------------------------------------------
# 5.1 Gráfica de línea: Germinación acumulada en el tiempo
# ----------------------------------------------------
plot_git <- git %>%
  fplot(
    data    = .,
    type    = "line",
    x       = "evaluation",
    y       = "mean",
    group   = "Tratamiento",
    ylimits = c(0, 110, 10),
    ylab    = expression(paste("Germinación (%)")),  # Usamos paste para mostrar el %
    xlab    = "Días (0-5)",
    color   = TRUE,
    error   = "ste",
    loess.span   = 1.0,   # Aumentamos span para evitar advertencias de LOESS
    loess.degree = 1      # Ajuste lineal en lugar de cuadrático para mayor estabilidad
  )

# Mostramos la gráfica de germinación en el tiempo
plot_git

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# 6. DIAGNÓSTICOS ADICIONALES DEL SNK (opcional)
# ---------------------------------------------------
# Suprimimos warnings de LOESS y mejoramos ejes numéricos
suppressWarnings({
  diag_plots_original <- mc_mgt$diagplot

  diag_plots_ajustados <- lapply(diag_plots_original, function(p) {
    p +
      # Formateamos ejes X e Y con comas en miles
      scale_y_continuous(labels = comma_format()) +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = comma_format()) +
      # Tema más ligero y texto más pequeño
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
      )
  })

  # Combinamos los gráficos ajustados en un solo layout
  plot_grid(
    plotlist = diag_plots_ajustados,
    ncol     = 2,
    labels   = "auto"
  )
})

```

```{r}
# ===========================================================
# 5-bis · IVG + % final — versión ggplot2 (sin plot_smr)
# ===========================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)       # dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2
  if (!requireNamespace("agricolae", quietly = TRUE))
      install.packages("agricolae", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  library(agricolae)
})

## ---------- 1 · ÍNDICE DE VELOCIDAD DE GERMINACIÓN ----------
# Incremento diario y IVG
fb_inc <- fb %>% 
  dplyr::select(plots, Tratamiento, dplyr::starts_with("d")) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::starts_with("d"),
                      names_to = "dia", values_to = "cum") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    dia_num = as.numeric(stringr::str_remove(dia, "d")),
    cum     = tidyr::replace_na(cum, 0)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(plots, dia_num) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(plots) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(inc = cum - dplyr::lag(cum, default = 0)) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup()

ivg_raw <- fb_inc %>% 
  dplyr::filter(dia_num > 0) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(plots, Tratamiento) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(ivg = sum(inc / dia_num), .groups = "drop")

# ANOVA + SNK
av_ivg  <- aov(ivg ~ Tratamiento, data = ivg_raw)
snk_ivg <- agricolae::SNK.test(av_ivg, "Tratamiento", group = TRUE, console = FALSE)

ivg_letters <- snk_ivg$groups %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Tratamiento") %>% 
  dplyr::select(Tratamiento, sig = groups)

ivg_sum <- ivg_raw %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Tratamiento) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    ivg = mean(ivg),
    se  = sd(ivg) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(ivg_letters, by = "Tratamiento")

# Gráfico IVG
ivg_plot <- ggplot(ivg_sum, aes(x = Tratamiento, y = ivg)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4F81BD", width = 0.65) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ivg - se, ymax = ivg + se), width = .2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, y = ivg + se + 0.05), size = 4) +
  labs(y = "Índice de velocidad de germinación",
       x = "Tratamiento") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

## ---------- 2 · PORCENTAJE FINAL DE GERMINACIÓN ------------
ultimo_dia <- max(git$evaluation, na.rm = TRUE)   # debería ser 5

pct_raw <- fb %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_final = .data[[paste0("d", ultimo_dia)]] / seeds * 100
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(plots, Tratamiento, pct_final)

av_pct  <- aov(pct_final ~ Tratamiento, data = pct_raw)
snk_pct <- agricolae::SNK.test(av_pct, "Tratamiento", group = TRUE, console = FALSE)

pct_letters <- snk_pct$groups %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Tratamiento") %>% 
  dplyr::select(Tratamiento, sig = groups)

pct_sum <- pct_raw %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Tratamiento) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(pct_final),
    se   = sd(pct_final) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(pct_letters, by = "Tratamiento")

# Gráfico % final
pct_plot <- ggplot(pct_sum, aes(x = Tratamiento, y = mean)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#E46C0A", width = 0.65) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = .2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig, y = mean + se + 2), size = 4) +
  labs(y = "Germinación final (%)",
       x = "Tratamiento") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

## ---------- 3 · mostrar inmediatamente --------------------
print(ivg_plot)
print(pct_plot)

```
